senses.gloss: f. (denom. of קעילה) of Keilah, a town in the lowland district of Judæa.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 76a:15">Yoma 76ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>דבילה ק׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D00059"><he>דְּבֵילָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3:2">Y. Bicc. III, beg. 65ᶜ</cite> <he>בקש … נאמר אם היתה ק׳ וכ׳</he> if one wants to bring (as first fruits) pressed figs, shall we say, if they are from Keilah, he may, if from Bozrah, he dare not?
